name: Gnomeregan
location: North-west Dun Morogh (24, 40). Alliance: elevator from Ironforge. Horde: Chief Engineer Scooty's Goblin Transponder from Booty Bay
strategy: Grubbis: kill his pet Chomper first
Viscous Fallout: immune to Frost
Electrocutioner 6000: spread out; tank at max melee range (Chain Bolt can't be interrupted); drops the Workshop Key
Crowd Pummeler 9-60: tank against a wall away from the healer; ranged at max range
Dark Iron Ambassador (rare): kill Burning Servants as they spawn, interrupt Fireball
Mekgineer Thermaplugg: tank in the middle; retaunt after Knock Away; kill Walking Bombs or press the pillar buttons

name: Razorfen Kraul
strategy: Roogug: kill the Death's Head Seer first
Aggem Thorncurse: kill the low-health boar spirits fast
Death Speaker Jargba: Acolyte, then Groundshaker, then Jargba
Overlord Ramtusk: keep the Spearhides away; melee step out before Whirling Barrage
Earthcaller Halmgar (rare): kill the Stone Rumbler and totems, interrupt Lightning Bolt
Agathelos the Raging: keep the tank alive; keep hitting through his feign death
Blind Hunter (rare): clear bats, taunt him away from casters (Sonic Burst silences)
Charlga Razorflank: spread for Chain Bolt; skip DoTs (Purity dispels them)

name: Razorfen Downs
location: South-east Barrens (43, 95), through a bramble maze of elite quilboar
strategy: Tuten'kash: ring the gong three times (first two bring spiders); face him away from Web Spray; decurse
Plaugemaw the Rotting (escort): keep adds off the NPC
Mordresh Fire Eye: AoE the skeletons, interrupt Fireball
Ragglesnout (rare): interrupt Heal and Shadow Bolt; watch for Dominate Mind
Glutton: face away; heal through the enrage; avoid Disease Cloud
Amnennar the Coldbringer: face away, stack behind; ranged kill Frost Spectres

name: Uldaman
location: Northern Badlands (44, 12) via elite tunnels; back door at Dustwind Gulch (66, 43)
strategy: The Lost Dwarves (Horde only): kill Eric, then Olaf, then Baelog
Revelosh: interrupt Chain Lightning; clear the adds
Ironaya: face away (Arcing Smash); immune to DoTs
Obsidian Sentinel: kill the Obsidian Shards at 66% and 33%
Ancient Stone Keeper: ranged at max range to avoid the silence
Galgann Firehammer: kill the Geologists first; dispel Amplify Flames
Grimlok: crowd-control adds (kill the Basilisk first if short on CC); tank near a wall
Archaedas: pull at range and fight in the previous chamber; kill adds as they wake; spread for Ground Tremor
tips: Same layout and bosses as Classic, with loot updates

name: Zul'Farrak
strategy: Zerillis: pull him to a safe spot with line of sight
Antu'sul: pull him out of his cave; handle the basilisks; interrupt both heals
Theka the Martyr: stun near 30% to stop his transform; dispel Fevered Plague
Witch Doctor Zum'rah: interrupt; a physical DPS kills totems; clear zombies
Dustwraith: focus the boss; crowd-control adds
Shadowpriest Sezz'ziz: kill Nekrum Gutchewer first while interrupting heals
Sergeant Bly: kill Murta, Oro, Raven, then Bly
Chief Ukorz Sandscalp: face him at a wall; kill Ruuzlu first
Hydromancer Velratha: clear adds first; interrupt; kill totems
Gahz'rilla: needs the Mallet of Zul'Farrak to ring the gong; tank in the pool
Sandarr Dunereaver: pull without adds
tips: Guide is based on Classic (not testable in the beta)

name: Scarlet Monastery: Graveyard
strategy: Interrogator Vishas: mark and kill his adds first
Ironspire (rare): pull him out of poison clouds; decurse Curse of Weakness
Fallen Champion (rare): face away (Cleave)
Azshir the Sleepless (rare): clear adds; interrupt Soul Siphon
Bloodmage Thalnos: ranged stay away from Flame Spike
tips: Only two bosses always spawn; the others are rare
The Graveyard portal is the leftmost in the main building

name: Scarlet Monastery: Library
strategy: Houndmaster Loksey: mark and focus the hounds; dispel Bloodlust
Arcanist Doan: during Detonation, leave his platform and hug the walls; stay 30 yards away from Polymorph; his chest has The Scarlet Key
tips: The Scarlet Key opens the Armory and Cathedral

name: Scarlet Monastery: Armory
strategy: Herod: step away during Whirlwind (he's immune then); be ready for the Crusaders that flood in after he dies

name: Scarlet Monastery: Cathedral
strategy: High Inquisitor Fairbanks: interrupt his Heal; he dispels the tank often
Scarlet Commander Mograine & High Inquisitor Whitemane: build threat fast when Whitemane joins in phase two; manage mana

name: Maraudon
location: Valley of Spears, Desolace: through the Stone Door (38, 58) into the caverns
strategy: Tinkerer Gizlock: face away, everyone behind
Lord Vyletongue: stack on him; kill him first; re-stack after Blink
Noxxion: pull onto land; kill each split copy
Razorlash: heal the Puncture target
Celebras the Cursed: focus the boss (killing adds summons more)
Meshlok the Harvester: looks like normal mobs at Poison Falls; spread for War Stomp
Landslide: back to a wall; focus the boss, not the adds
Rotgrip: pull him up from the water; cooldowns for Fatal Bite
Princess Theradras: tank at the back of the platform; ranged avoid Dust Field; Fear Ward or Tremor Totem for Repulsive Gaze
tips: The Scepter of Celebras teleports you to Earth Song Falls

name: Temple of Atal'Hakkar (Sunken Temple)
location: In the lake of Swamp of Sorrows; Horde from Stonard, Alliance via Deadwind Pass or Nethergarde Keep
strategy: Atal'alarion: walk down to the Pit of Refuse (don't jump); face him at a wall
Spawn of Hakkar: heal players hit by Acid of Hakkar
Troll mini-bosses: tank each and burn
Jammal'an the Prophet: kill Ogom first; spread for Flamestrike and Hex
Weaver & Dreamscythe: one drake at a time, faced at a wall
Hazzas & Morphaz: tank both at a wall facing away
Shade of Eranikus: clear the dragonkin; rotate tanks during Deep Slumber (Grounding Totem helps)
Avatar of Hakkar: kill the four Bloodkeepers and put out the braziers; crowd-control the player hit by Cause Insanity
